result:
No actions this turn. I'd reply first, before building anything.

---

You want a better way to track what the seed library lends out and what comes back. Today that's a shared spreadsheet: one row per loan, with seed, number of packets, borrower, date out and date back.

One thing stood out. About a third of the rows have no "date back." Those rows could mean very different things, and I can't tell which from the sheet alone:
- seeds still out this season
- returns that happened but nobody wrote down
- loans that were never going to come back as the same packets

Seed libraries also differ in what "coming back" means. Some ask people to return seed they saved from their own harvest, which may be a different amount or arrive a season later. So what the system has to record depends a lot on how your library actually works.

Before I suggest anything, I'd like to hear it from your side: **what goes wrong with the spreadsheet today, and what made you want to fix it now?** Your answer decides what the new tool needs to be good at. That could be catching what's overdue, making returns easy to log on the spot, or something else entirely.
